incident-bot: Pager: elevated 429 + latency for org NovusEdge (org_9382). Spike began ~6162246700, current qps ~8x baseline. Alerting on error-rate and tail latency.
priya (on-call SRE): I'm taking this. looking at grafana now — loading top endpoints.
jamal (eng): seeing huge burst on /v1/embed and /v1/generate for this org. Their request patterns look like long-context batched jobs.
elin (product): NovusEdge confirmed they're running a new nightly job. asked them to pause but might take time. they said it's high-priority.
mike (ops): we should consider temporary quota bump + introduce short lived per-org token bucket to smooth. can we open a quick override?
priya (on-call SRE): agree. planning coordinated mitigation: 1) apply emergency per-org throttle to cap concurrency at 20 2) bump token quota by +50% for 10m to avoid hard 429s during in-flight work 3) enable prefix caching for their heavy prompt if possible.
jamal (eng): I can push a targeted feature-gate: disable streaming for that org (reduces KV pressure) — will take ~2m. want ops to apply quota change first to avoid immediate client failures.
mike (ops): applying quota bump now. running admin API:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://admin.redwood/api/v1/orgs/org_9382/overrides"
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"quota_delta_pct":50, "duration_minutes":10, "reason":"emergency burst - NovusEdge nightly job"}'
```
incident-bot: Override applied by mike at 6162246902 — temp quota +50% for 10m.
priya (on-call SRE): confirmed - ingestion error rate dropped from 12% -> 5% in 60s, p99 latency still elevated. proceeding to cap concurrency (20) for org via rate limiter config.
mike (ops): applying concurrency cap: `rlctl set org org_9382 concurrency=20 --reason "mitigation"`
incident-bot: Concurrency cap applied at 6162246930.
jamal (eng): disabled streaming for org_9382 via feature-gate FR-1429 (rolled back non-streaming quickly), should reduce KV memory churn.
elin (product): NovusEdge notified. they paused the nightly job at our request — thanks.
priya (on-call SRE): monitoring: errors down to 1.2%, qps back to ~1.5x baseline. will keep the override for remaining window and watch for regressions. leaving a short runbook for handoff.
sara (next-oncall): I'm taking next shift in 30m; loop me in on status and playbook.
priya (on-call SRE): Handoff notes -> mitigation steps executed: quota +50% (6162246902), concurrency cap 20 (6162246930), streaming disabled FR-1429, contacted customer to pause job. Metrics to watch: 429 rate, p99 latency, GPU mem pressure. Link: https://grafana.redwood/d/novusedge-spike
jamal (eng): follow-up action: schedule a rate-limit tuning follow-up with NovusEdge to recommend backoff + batching limits; propose a longer-term per-customer adaptive throttler.
priya (on-call SRE): closing active mitigation at 6162247020 — traffic normalized, lifted temp quota at 6162247015 and removed concurrency cap at 6162247018. leaving incident for postmortem.
incident-bot: Incident record created: INC-2026-9382. Pager cleared.
priya (on-call SRE): postmortem TODOs: (1) add automated detection for repeated nightly bursts per-org (2) quick UI button for temporary safe-bump (3) evaluate adaptive throttler prototype.
sara (next-oncall): thanks — I'll pick this up for the morning follow-up. :thumbsup:
